name: ByteDance: Seedance 2 Mini
description: Seedance 2 Mini (often branded as Dreamina Seedance 2.0 Mini on BytePlus ModelArk) is a low-cost, fast text-to-video and image-to-video generation model that produces short 480p or 720p clips with optional native audio. It is designed for rapid iteration and everyday production workflows where speed and cost efficiency matter more than maximum resolution or fidelity.
